newsitem.title: DUBAI: MashreqBank's net profit rises 8 percent.
newsitem.headline: MashreqBank's net profit rises 8 percent.

text.p: MashreqBank in the United Arab Emirates posted an eight percent increase in net profit to 350.5 million dirhams ($95.5 million) last year from 324 million dirhams in 1995, the daily Al-Khaleej said on Friday.
Earnings per share reached 64.6 dirhams with a dividend of 30 dirhams, the paper said, reporting on the bank's annual general meeting. No comparative figures were immediately available.
Operating profit rose by 14.7 percent to 894.6 million dirhams, it said. Operating costs were up 19.4 percent to 544.1 million dirhams.
Assets rose by 11 percent to 15.3 billion dirhams, while liabilities increased by 10.7 percent to 13.65 billion dirhams. ($1=3.67 dirhams)
